# Adding CMS functionality to admin panel (2025-11-22 22:59Z)

_**User (2025-11-22 20:18Z)**_

We have been working on converting this repo over to having an Admin panel @ `admin/` and a lot of the data being saved in databases. Examples would be the Documents, Portfolios, Side Projects and such.

We have some pages that have static hard-coded text that are just in the html of the page. It makes sense to possibly add these into the Admin panel as well so that they can more easily be updated in the backend and reflected on the frontend where it is pulled from the database.

On our page page `index.html` we have a section called “About Me”, that maybe we can create a “CMS Blocks” section in the admin panel where we have a block ID that would be hard coded in the html files on the frontend and based on the block ID we pull that ID’s data from the database to display on the given html frontend page.

Here are some pages and sections:

- `index.html`

    - About Me

- `contact.html`

    - Maybe we can make up the different fields that are on this page in the backend on an editable form.

- `personal.html`

    - A Little About Me

    - Family First

    - Hobbies & Interests

    - Life in Photos

    - Values & Philosophy

- We also have the header where it says my name “Bradley R. Clampit” then it has a set of titles like this “Digital Solutions Architect & Tech Leader | Magento 2 Expert | Cloud & DevOps Strategist | eCommerce Scalability Architect”



Does this seem like something we should or could add in to the backend admin panel? We could have a section maybe for General CMS but I want your input before we make changes.

A CMS Blocks system fits your architecture. Here’s a concise assessment and recommendations:

## Assessment: Yes, this makes sense

**Pros:**
1. Consistent with your existing pattern (Documents, Portfolios, etc.)
2. Enables non-technical content updates
3. Flexible for future content needs
4. Keeps content versioned in the database

**Considerations:**
1. Header content (name, titles) is reused across pages — consider a separate "Site Settings" or "General Settings" table
2. Contact page fields may be better as structured data (name/value pairs) rather than blocks
3. Personal page sections are good candidates for CMS blocks

## Recommended structure

### Option 1: CMS Blocks (for page sections)
- Block ID (e.g., `about-me`, `family-first`)
- Title (optional, for admin display)
- Content (HTML/Markdown)
- Status (active/inactive)
- Created/Updated timestamps

### Option 2: Site Settings (for header/global content)
- Key (e.g., `site_name`, `site_titles`, `site_description`)
- Value (text/JSON)
- Type (text, html, json)

### Option 3: Hybrid approach
- CMS Blocks for page sections
- Site Settings for header/global content
- Contact Info as structured fields (email, phone, social links)

## Recommendation

Use a hybrid:
1. CMS Blocks for page sections (About Me, Family First, etc.)
2. Site Settings for header content (name, titles, description)
3. Contact Info as structured fields (email, phone, LinkedIn, etc.)

This keeps content manageable and avoids overloading blocks with settings.

Should I proceed with this implementation? I can:
1. Create the database schema
2. Add admin panel routes and templates
3. Create an API endpoint for frontend consumption
4. Show how to integrate it into your HTML files

Or would you prefer to discuss the structure first?

+ PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;
+ 
+ -- CMS Blocks: Reusable content blocks for pages
+ CREATE TABLE cms_blocks (
+     id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+     block_id        TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,  -- Unique identifier used in HTML (e.g., &#39;about-me&#39;, &#39;family-first&#39;)
+     title           TEXT NOT NULL,          -- Display title for admin panel
+     content         TEXT NOT NULL,         -- HTML/Markdown content
+     content_format  TEXT DEFAULT &#39;html&#39;,   -- &#39;html&#39; or &#39;markdown&#39;
+     description     TEXT,                   -- Optional description for admin
+     is_active       INTEGER DEFAULT 1,      -- 1 = active, 0 = inactive
+     sort_order      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,      -- For ordering blocks
+     created_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;)),
+     updated_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;))
+ );
+ 
+ CREATE INDEX idx_cms_blocks_block_id ON cms_blocks(block_id);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_cms_blocks_active ON cms_blocks(is_active);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_cms_blocks_sort ON cms_blocks(sort_order);
+ 
+ -- Site Settings: Global site configuration
+ CREATE TABLE site_settings (
+     id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+     setting_key     TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,  -- e.g., &#39;site_name&#39;, &#39;site_titles&#39;, &#39;site_description&#39;
+     setting_value   TEXT NOT NULL,         -- The actual value
+     setting_type    TEXT DEFAULT &#39;text&#39;,   -- &#39;text&#39;, &#39;html&#39;, &#39;json&#39;
+     description     TEXT,                   -- What this setting controls
+     updated_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;))
+ );
+ 
+ CREATE INDEX idx_site_settings_key ON site_settings(setting_key);
+ 
+ -- Contact Info: Structured contact information
+ CREATE TABLE contact_info (
+     id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+     field_name      TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,  -- e.g., &#39;email&#39;, &#39;phone&#39;, &#39;linkedin&#39;, &#39;github&#39;
+     label           TEXT NOT NULL,         -- Display label (e.g., &#39;Email&#39;, &#39;Phone&#39;)

+                     &lt;template x-for=&quot;size in perPageOptions&quot; :key=&quot;&#39;block-size-&#39; + size&quot;&gt;

+             
+             &lt;div class=&quot;flex items-center gap-2&quot;&gt;
+                 &lt;button type=&quot;button&quot; class=&quot;rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 disabled:opacity-40&quot; @click=&quot;prevPage&quot; :disabled=&quot;currentPage === 1&quot;&gt;Prev&lt;/button&gt;
+                 &lt;template x-for=&quot;page in pageNumbers()&quot; :key=&quot;&#39;block-page-&#39; + page&quot;&gt;
+                     &lt;button type=&quot;button&quot; class=&quot;rounded-lg border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold&quot; 
+                             :class=&quot;page === currentPage ? &#39;border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700&#39; : &#39;border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100&#39;&quot; 
+                             @click=&quot;goToPage(page)&quot; 
+                             x-text=&quot;page&quot;&gt;&lt;/button&gt;
+                 &lt;/template&gt;
+                 &lt;button type=&quot;button&quot; class=&quot;rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 disabled:opacity-40&quot; @click=&quot;nextPage&quot; :disabled=&quot;currentPage === totalPages()&quot;&gt;Next&lt;/button&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;

+     &lt;/section&gt;

+ 
+ &lt;script&gt;
+ function blocksTable(initial) {
+     return {
+         perPageOptions: [10, 20, 30, 50, 100],
+         perPage: 10,
+         currentPage: 1,
+         blocks: initial.blocks || [],
+         init() {
+             this.$watch(&#39;perPage&#39;, () =&gt; { this.currentPage = 1; });
+         },
+         totalPages() {
+             const total = this.blocks.length;
+             return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / this.perPage));
+         },
+         paginatedBlocks() {
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage;
+             return this.blocks.slice(start, start + this.perPage);
+         },
+         goToPage(page) {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             this.currentPage = Math.min(Math.max(page, 1), total);
+         },
+         prevPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage - 1);
+         },
+         nextPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage + 1);
+         },
+         pageNumbers() {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             if (total === 0) return [];
+             if (total === 1) return [1];
+             
+             const current = this.currentPage;
+             const pages = [];
+             
+             const start = Math.max(1, current - 1);
+             const end = Math.min(total, current + 1);
+             
+             for (let i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {
+                 pages.push(i);
+             }
+             
+             return pages;
+         },
+         rangeSummary() {
+             if (!this.blocks.length) {
+                 return &#39;Showing 0 items&#39;;
+             }
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage + 1;
+             const end = Math.min(start + this.perPage - 1, this.blocks.length);
+             return &#96;Showing ${start}-${end} of ${this.blocks.length} items&#96;;
+         },
+     };
+ }
+ &lt;/script&gt;
+ {% endblock %}
+

+ &lt;script&gt;
+ let editor;

+ document.addEventListener(&#39;DOMContentLoaded&#39;, function() {
+     const contentFormat = document.getElementById(&#39;content_format&#39;).value;
+     const initialContent = document.getElementById(&#39;content&#39;).value;
+     
+     const Editor = toastui.Editor;
+     const { codeSyntaxHighlight } = Editor.plugin;
+     
+     editor = new Editor({
+         el: document.querySelector(&#39;#editor&#39;),
+         height: &#39;500px&#39;,
+         initialEditType: contentFormat === &#39;markdown&#39; ? &#39;markdown&#39; : &#39;wysiwyg&#39;,
+         previewStyle: &#39;vertical&#39;,
+         plugins: [codeSyntaxHighlight],
+         initialValue: initialContent,
+         toolbarItems: [
+             [&#39;heading&#39;, &#39;bold&#39;, &#39;italic&#39;, &#39;strike&#39;],
+             [&#39;hr&#39;, &#39;quote&#39;],
+             [&#39;ul&#39;, &#39;ol&#39;, &#39;task&#39;, &#39;indent&#39;, &#39;outdent&#39;],
+             [&#39;table&#39;, &#39;image&#39;, &#39;link&#39;],
+             [&#39;code&#39;, &#39;codeblock&#39;],
+             [&#39;scrollSync&#39;],
+         ],
+     });
+     
+     // Update editor when format changes
+     document.getElementById(&#39;content_format&#39;).addEventListener(&#39;change&#39;, function() {
+         const newFormat = this.value;
+         const currentContent = editor.getMarkdown();
+         editor.destroy();
+         
+         editor = new Editor({
+             el: document.querySelector(&#39;#editor&#39;),
+             height: &#39;500px&#39;,
+             initialEditType: newFormat === &#39;markdown&#39; ? &#39;markdown&#39; : &#39;wysiwyg&#39;,
+             previewStyle: &#39;vertical&#39;,
+             plugins: [codeSyntaxHighlight],
+             initialValue: currentContent,
+             toolbarItems: [
+                 [&#39;heading&#39;, &#39;bold&#39;, &#39;italic&#39;, &#39;strike&#39;],
+                 [&#39;hr&#39;, &#39;quote&#39;],
+                 [&#39;ul&#39;, &#39;ol&#39;, &#39;task&#39;, &#39;indent&#39;, &#39;outdent&#39;],
+                 [&#39;table&#39;, &#39;image&#39;, &#39;link&#39;],
+                 [&#39;code&#39;, &#39;codeblock&#39;],
+                 [&#39;scrollSync&#39;],
+             ],
+         });
+     });
+ });
+ 
+ function syncEditorContent() {
+     const content = editor.getHTML();
+     document.getElementById(&#39;content&#39;).value = content;
+     return true;
+ }
+ &lt;/script&gt;
+ {% endblock %}
+ 
```

+                         &lt;option value=&quot;text&quot; :selected=&quot;editingSetting?.setting_type === &#39;text&#39;&quot;&gt;Text&lt;/option&gt;
+                         &lt;option value=&quot;html&quot; :selected=&quot;editingSetting?.setting_type === &#39;html&#39;&quot;&gt;HTML&lt;/option&gt;
+                         &lt;option value=&quot;json&quot; :selected=&quot;editingSetting?.setting_type === &#39;json&#39;&quot;&gt;JSON&lt;/option&gt;
+                     &lt;/select&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 
+                 &lt;div&gt;
+                     &lt;label class=&quot;block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1&quot;&gt;Value&lt;/label&gt;
+                     &lt;textarea name=&quot;setting_value&quot; required rows=&quot;5&quot;
+                               :value=&quot;editingSetting?.setting_value&quot;
+                               class=&quot;w-full px-3 py-2 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500&quot;&gt;&lt;/textarea&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 
+                 &lt;div&gt;
+                     &lt;label class=&quot;block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1&quot;&gt;Description&lt;/label&gt;
+                     &lt;input type=&quot;text&quot; name=&quot;description&quot;
+                            :value=&quot;editingSetting?.description || &#39;&#39;&quot;
+                            class=&quot;w-full px-3 py-2 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500&quot;&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 
+                 &lt;div class=&quot;flex gap-3&quot;&gt;
+                     &lt;button type=&quot;submit&quot; class=&quot;bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition&quot;&gt;Save&lt;/button&gt;
+                     &lt;button type=&quot;button&quot; @click=&quot;editingSetting = null&quot; class=&quot;bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-300 transition&quot;&gt;Cancel&lt;/button&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/form&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+ &lt;/div&gt;

+ &lt;script&gt;
+ function settingsTable(initial) {
+     return {
+         perPageOptions: [10, 20, 30, 50, 100],
+         perPage: 10,
+         currentPage: 1,
+         settings: initial.settings || [],
+         showAddForm: false,
+         editingSetting: null,
+         init() {
+             this.$watch(&#39;perPage&#39;, () =&gt; { this.currentPage = 1; });
+         },
+         totalPages() {
+             const total = this.settings.length;
+             return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / this.perPage));
+         },
+         paginatedSettings() {
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage;
+             return this.settings.slice(start, start + this.perPage);
+         },
+         goToPage(page) {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             this.currentPage = Math.min(Math.max(page, 1), total);
+         },
+         prevPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage - 1);
+         },
+         nextPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage + 1);
+         },
+         pageNumbers() {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             if (total === 0) return [];
+             if (total === 1) return [1];
+             
+             const current = this.currentPage;
+             const pages = [];
+             
+             const start = Math.max(1, current - 1);
+             const end = Math.min(total, current + 1);
+             
+             for (let i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {
+                 pages.push(i);
+             }
+             
+             return pages;
+         },
+         rangeSummary() {
+             if (!this.settings.length) {
+                 return &#39;Showing 0 items&#39;;
+             }
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage + 1;
+             const end = Math.min(start + this.perPage - 1, this.settings.length);
+             return &#96;Showing ${start}-${end} of ${this.settings.length} items&#96;;
+         },
+         editSetting(setting) {
+             this.editingSetting = { ...setting };
+         },
+     };
+ }
+ &lt;/script&gt;
+ {% endblock %}
+ 
```

</details>

</tool-use>

+ &lt;script&gt;
+ function contactTable(initial) {
+     return {
+         perPageOptions: [10, 20, 30, 50, 100],
+         perPage: 10,
+         currentPage: 1,
+         contact_fields: initial.contact_fields || [],
+         showAddForm: false,
+         editingField: null,
+         init() {
+             this.$watch(&#39;perPage&#39;, () =&gt; { this.currentPage = 1; });
+         },
+         totalPages() {
+             const total = this.contact_fields.length;
+             return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / this.perPage));
+         },
+         paginatedFields() {
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage;
+             return this.contact_fields.slice(start, start + this.perPage);
+         },
+         goToPage(page) {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             this.currentPage = Math.min(Math.max(page, 1), total);
+         },
+         prevPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage - 1);
+         },
+         nextPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage + 1);
+         },
+         pageNumbers() {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             if (total === 0) return [];
+             if (total === 1) return [1];
+             
+             const current = this.currentPage;
+             const pages = [];
+             
+             const start = Math.max(1, current - 1);
+             const end = Math.min(total, current + 1);
+             
+             for (let i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {
+                 pages.push(i);
+             }
+             
+             return pages;
+         },
+         rangeSummary() {
+             if (!this.contact_fields.length) {
+                 return &#39;Showing 0 items&#39;;
+             }
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage + 1;
+             const end = Math.min(start + this.perPage - 1, this.contact_fields.length);
+             return &#96;Showing ${start}-${end} of ${this.contact_fields.length} items&#96;;
+         },
+         editField(field) {
+             this.editingField = { ...field };
+         },
+     };
+ }
+ &lt;/script&gt;
+ {% endblock %}

Implementation complete. Summary:

## Implementation complete

### What was created

1. Database schemas (`cms/schema.sql`):
   - `cms_blocks` — reusable content blocks
   - `site_settings` — global site configuration
   - `contact_info` — structured contact fields

2. Admin routes (`admin/app.py`):
   - CMS Blocks: list, create, edit, delete
   - Site Settings: list, create, edit, delete
   - Contact Info: list, create, edit, delete

3. Admin templates (AlpineJS):
   - `cms/blocks_list.html` — paginated list with search
   - `cms/blocks_edit.html` — rich text editor (Toast UI)
   - `cms/settings_list.html` — inline editing modal
   - `cms/contact_list.html` — inline editing modal

4. API endpoints:
   - `/api/cms/blocks` — active blocks by block_id
   - `/api/cms/settings` — all settings as key-value pairs
   - `/api/cms/contact` — public contact fields

5. Navigation:
   - Added CMS section to admin sidebar with expandable menu

### How to use

1. Access the admin panel:
   - CMS Blocks: `/admin/cms/blocks`
   - Site Settings: `/admin/cms/settings`
   - Contact Info: `/admin/cms/contact`

2. Frontend integration:
   ```javascript
   // Fetch CMS blocks
   fetch('/api/cms/blocks')
     .then(r => r.json())
     .then(data => {
       const aboutMeBlock = data.blocks['about-me'];
       // Use aboutMeBlock.content in your HTML
     });
   
   // Fetch site settings
   fetch('/api/cms/settings')
     .then(r => r.json())
     .then(data => {
       const siteName = data.settings.site_name;
       const siteTitles = data.settings.site_titles;
     });
   
   // Fetch contact info
   fetch('/api/cms/contact')
     .then(r => r.json())
     .then(data => {
       data.contact_fields.forEach(field => {
         // Render contact fields
       });
     });
   ```

3. In HTML:
   - Use block IDs like `data-cms-block="about-me"` and load content via JavaScript
   - Replace hardcoded header text with settings from the API
   - Replace contact page fields with data from the contact API

### Features

- Responsive admin UI with AlpineJS
- Rich text editor (HTML/Markdown) for CMS blocks
- Pagination and search
- Active/inactive status for blocks
- Public/hidden status for contact fields
- Sort ordering for all items
- API endpoints for frontend consumption

The system is ready to use. You can start creating CMS blocks, updating site settings, and managing contact information through the admin panel.
